questions: In fully visible frames, does the component keep the normal upright/stable posture instead of lying on its side?
Does the component avoid tumbling, strong wobbling, rolling, or unstable rotation while moving?
Are the red cap and black pin side visible as opposite ends of the same component, with no clear reversed-orientation evidence?
Does the component move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT across the video?
Does the component stay fully on the belt surface without overhanging, falling, or leaving the belt?

question_answers.evidence: The component slides on its base with pins facing upwards, maintaining a stable posture throughout the transit.
The component moves steadily without tumbling, rolling, or significant wobbling.
The red cap and metal pins are visible on the upper side of the component, consistent with a standard upright orientation.
The component enters from the left and translates smoothly to the right across the belt.
The component remains fully on the green belt surface from entry to exit.

parsed.reason: The component moves smoothly from left to right in a stable orientation, staying fully on the belt surface without tumbling or falling.

description: Normal push-button component moving left to right on the conveyor belt.
